body: Follow-up fix (25.11.2026): The first Windows shim fix still passed the Cursor .cmd path through Node's shell with an unquoted path, which can split 'C:\\Program Files\\...' at the space. Added an explicit cmd.exe /d /s /c spawn spec with Windows verbatim arguments for batch shims, shared by ACP startup and preflight. The Mastra process must be restarted to load the change. Live ACP execution remains unverified; keep MAST-49 open.
author: codex
